name: Sixteen Stairs
line: Sixteen steps down through the ice. The fish can come up them if they like.

name: A Door That Is Also a Boat
line: Open it and you are already halfway across the lake.

name: The Smell of Bread
line: No bread anywhere. Follow it and the stove is lit.

name: Bo's Big Needle
line: A needle the length of a ski. Bo would know what it is for.

name: A Window Facing Yesterday
line: The snow in it has not fallen yet.

name: A Spoon
line: A spoon. Just a spoon. You went down there for this.
